reason: Fixed. Channels are computed by the caller: HTTP handlers call api._search_channels and pass the result; A2A and the CLI pass None, as neither runs that step today. The pipeline never imports _search_channels. The guess that _load_gazetteer and _build_entity_patterns live in api.py was wrong: they are in nexus/index/graph_extractor.py and api.py imports them, which is why tests patch them there.
Fixed. §3 now lists the steps each surface runs today (A2A and the CLI: entity detection, route, search, no channel step), and the pipeline runs only those steps per caller. No surface gains a step.
Fixed by the I-001/I-002 change; the backstop reread now says no surface gains a retrieval step. The second point is wrong: ADR-0008 is accepted, not in review.

Fixed. The 'by structural design' claim is removed. packet_for_answer stays injected because two test files patch it on nexus.api; the SPEC says the seam is held by one call site plus the test, and the A2A and CLI deps always bind reconcile.packet_for_answer.

Fixed. The seam test asserts surfaces call retrieve_for_answer and not hybrid_search/packet_for_answer themselves, and checks what the A2A/CLI deps bind. The mutation check is defined: parse answer_pipeline.py with ast, drop the call node, run the same walker, expect failure; an ordinary pytest case in the unit job.

Fixed. _resolve_read_scope is a private helper in api.py and reads effective_read_scope from the nexus.api namespace at call time, so the existing patch in test_answer_says_what_it_searched.py keeps working.
Fixed in part. A2A has no HTTP request, so it calls effective_read_scope directly, but it now emits the same out-of-scope warning event; acceptance lists A2A.

Fixed. §5 states the widening (A2A then matches what HTTP already allows). No Nexus deployment is running, so no issued token changes in the field. A negative test pins that a tenant outside read_tenants is refused.

Fixed. The five HTTP-only arguments are named (window, channels, exclude_doc_types, identifier_channel_asked, fusion_doc_agreement); they come from HTTP request fields A2A and the CLI do not have. An argument-set test pins each surface's set.
Fixed. The signature is defined (route, top_k, channels, search_opts, want_packet), Retrieval.packet is None when not built, and timings is hybrid_search's timing_ms passed through unchanged.
Fixed. POST /search runs the same front half today, so it calls retrieve_for_answer with want_packet=False and is in acceptance.

Fixed. The stream takes evidence_only in its request but ignores it, so the done event does not gain evidence_only; whether the stream should honour it is an open question. abstained/abstain_reason come from one shared helper (not packet.snippets → 'no_evidence').
Fixed. The allowlist is exactly {evidence_only}, written in the test with its reason.
Fixed. Neither seam test file patches nexus.api (verified: 0 calls); the clamp test's 13 patch lines stay as they are and only new cases are added.
Fixed. Acceptance is 'every existing test that patches nexus.api passes with its patch lines unchanged'; 118 stays only as a dated snapshot in §3.
Fixed. §4.4 is 'Callers' (four answer surfaces plus /search and /search/explain), and the backstop reread names the clamp fix and the added keys and says neither touches the retrieval stack.

Telemetry consolidation is out of scope. Each surface keeps its record_search call where it is today (A2A and the CLI both call it), and A2A's backend choice stays as SPEC-nexus-per-principal-answer-backend set it. The SPEC now says so.
